id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Single Station Management entity (STA) to up to 32 PHYs/MMDs over a shared MDC + MDIO pair; PHY selected by 5-bit PHYAD/PRTAD.

supported_topologies.name: Single STA, single PHY
supported_topologies.description: One MAC manages one PHY over MDC/MDIO.

supported_topologies.name: Single STA, multiple PHYs
supported_topologies.description: Shared MDC/MDIO; each PHY has a unique strapped PHYAD; non-selected PHYs leave MDIO high-impedance.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Initiates frame transmits (subject to CSMA/CD if half-duplex), recognises incoming frames, owns CRC-32 computation + verification.

Line-codes the MII / GMII byte stream onto the medium (and decodes incoming); responds to BMCR Reset / Loopback / Power Down / Isolate; sources TX_CLK + RX_CLK (MII) or RX_CLK (GMII); responds to MDC + MDIO management transactions.
Master of the MDIO bus; initiates all C22 / C45 read / write transactions; configures + monitors PHYs.
Adaptation layer that maps the speed-agnostic MAC service primitives to the speed-specific MII / GMII signals.
1000BASE-T link partners select MASTER (sources symbol clock) and SLAVE (recovers it) either by manual setting (reg 9) or by AutoNeg Next Page exchange.

bidirectional_mode.description: When SPC0=1, single data pin is used; MOSI becomes MOMI (master) or MISO becomes SISO (slave). BIDIROE controls the direction of the chosen pin.

fields.interconnect_role: The MII / GMII / RGMII are purely point-to-point MAC↔PHY interfaces; no fan-out is permitted. The MDIO management bus is a shared multi-drop bus with one STA master and up to 32 PHY slaves addressed by the 5-bit PHYAD. The MDI (medium) topology is governed by the PMD class — twisted pair is always point-to-point (full-duplex) in modern installations; fiber is always point-to-point; coax was the original shared-bus medium (10BASE2 / 10BASE5) but is no longer deployed.

ordering_guarantees.in_link_ordering: MAC delivers received frames to the upper layer in the order they were received from the PHY; no re-ordering at the MAC.
ordering_guarantees.vlan_priority: 802.1Q PCP[2:0] carries 8 traffic classes; switches may apply per-PCP queues + scheduling — at the MAC the PCP is just data.
ordering_guarantees.pause_flow_control: PAUSE applies to all traffic equally on a link (Clause 31); per-class PFC (priority-based flow control) is a separate IEEE 802.1Qbb extension above the base 802.3.
ordering_guarantees.broadcast_delivery: Broadcast and multicast frames are delivered to every station in the broadcast / multicast domain; switches replicate at egress ports.

ss_handling_per_topology.point_to_point_CPHA0: SS must toggle HIGH between bytes (min tI high time).
ss_handling_per_topology.point_to_point_CPHA1: SS may stay LOW continuously for back-to-back transfers.
ss_handling_per_topology.multi_slave: Each slave's SS individually driven LOW only when addressed.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — JTAG registers are not memory-mapped; selection is by IR opcode + TAP state.

slave_classification.duplex_slave: Capable of both transmit and receive; standard SPI slave.
slave_classification.receive_only_slave: Simpler slaves with no MISO output drive; master will not receive data from them.

default_signal_values_evidence_tables: Table 4-1 Normal Mode and Bidirectional Mode

ultra_fast_mode_topology.description: Push-pull, unidirectional master-to-slaves only. No arbitration, no clock stretching, no ACK.
ultra_fast_mode_topology.use_case: LED controllers, GPO devices that need fast unidirectional writes.

addressing_topology.10_bit: Optional. Two-byte address format: first byte 0b11110XX0/1 + 2 MSBs of address + R/W; second byte = 8 LSBs of address.

device_classification.master: Station Management entity (STA) in the MAC

fields.pull_up: MDIO requires an external pull-up resistor (1.5 kohm to 10 kohm) to the 1.2-3.3 V supply
